acs_cost_burden.definition: Share of owner-occupied units with a mortgage whose selected monthly owner costs are 30% or more of household income (excludes 'not computed')
acs_cost_burden.label: Mortgaged owners paying 30%+ of income on housing
acs_cost_burden.source: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, table B25091

acs_cost_burden_severe.definition: As acs_cost_burden, at 50% or more of household income
acs_cost_burden_severe.label: Mortgaged owners paying 50%+ of income on housing
acs_cost_burden_severe.source: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, table B25091

acs_property_tax_income.definition: Median real estate taxes paid (owner-occupied units, B25103) divided by median household income of owner-occupied households (B25119)
acs_property_tax_income.label: Property tax as % of owner income (ratio of medians)
acs_property_tax_income.source: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, tables B25103 and B25119

benchmarks.definition: b_PTI = 0.28 (housing at most 28% of gross income); d, r, s, cltv = 2019 national values, 50 states + DC (percent). Never recomputed from current data (DECISIONS 020).
benchmarks.label: Stress index benchmarks (fixed)

cfpb_delinquency_90.coverage_note: CFPB publishes only counties with at least 1,000 mortgages in its sample (DECISIONS 007)
cfpb_delinquency_90.definition: share of mortgages 90 or more days delinquent in the latest month (CFPB rounds to 0.1 points)
cfpb_delinquency_90.label: Mortgages 90+ days delinquent
cfpb_delinquency_90.source: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, Mortgage Performance Trends (National Mortgage Database), county 90+ days delinquent

cfpb_delinquency_change.coverage_note: CFPB publishes only counties with at least 1,000 mortgages in its sample (DECISIONS 007)
cfpb_delinquency_change.definition: latest 90+ day delinquency rate minus the county's 2017–2019 monthly mean
cfpb_delinquency_change.label: Change in 90+ day delinquency vs 2017–2019 average
cfpb_delinquency_change.source: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, Mortgage Performance Trends (National Mortgage Database), county 90+ days delinquent

cfpb_delinquency_z.coverage_note: CFPB publishes only counties with at least 1,000 mortgages in its sample (DECISIONS 007)
cfpb_delinquency_z.definition: (latest 90+ day delinquency rate − county's 2017–2019 monthly mean) ÷ county's 2017–2019 monthly SD, with the SD floored at 0.2 percentage points
cfpb_delinquency_z.label: Mortgage delinquency vs the county's own 2017–2019 baseline
cfpb_delinquency_z.source: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, Mortgage Performance Trends (National Mortgage Database), county 90+ days delinquent

hmda_cltv_over_90.definition: Share of qualifying conventional loans (loan_type 1) with combined_loan_to_value_ratio above 90
hmda_cltv_over_90.filters: originated, home purchase, first lien, principal residence; excludes open-end lines of credit and reverse mortgages
hmda_cltv_over_90.label: Conventional loans with combined loan-to-value above 90%
hmda_cltv_over_90.source: FFIEC Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) loan-level data

hmda_dti_over_43.definition: Share of qualifying loans with debt_to_income_ratio above 43% (reported values 44-49, '50%-60%', '>60%')
hmda_dti_over_43.filters: originated, home purchase, first lien, principal residence; excludes open-end lines of credit and reverse mortgages
hmda_dti_over_43.label: Loans with debt-to-income above 43%
hmda_dti_over_43.source: FFIEC Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) loan-level data

hmda_govt_share.definition: Share of qualifying loans that are FHA, VA or USDA/RHS (loan_type 2, 3 or 4)
hmda_govt_share.filters: originated, home purchase, first lien, principal residence; excludes open-end lines of credit and reverse mortgages
hmda_govt_share.label: Government-backed loans
hmda_govt_share.source: FFIEC Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) loan-level data

hmda_loan_amount.definition: Median loan_amount of qualifying loans (HMDA reports the midpoint of a $10,000 band)
hmda_loan_amount.filters: originated, home purchase, first lien, principal residence; excludes open-end lines of credit and reverse mortgages
hmda_loan_amount.label: Median loan amount
hmda_loan_amount.source: FFIEC Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) loan-level data

hmda_loans.filters: originated, home purchase, first lien, principal residence; excludes open-end lines of credit and reverse mortgages
hmda_loans.label: Qualifying home-purchase loans
hmda_loans.source: FFIEC Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) loan-level data

hmda_rate.filters: originated, home purchase, first lien, principal residence; excludes open-end lines of credit and reverse mortgages
hmda_rate.label: Median mortgage rate
hmda_rate.source: FFIEC Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) loan-level data

income.label: Median household income
income.source: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, table B19013

permits_per_1000_hh.definition: New residential units authorized by building permits in 2025 (all structure sizes, including imputation) per 1,000 households (ACS 2020–2024)
permits_per_1000_hh.label: Housing units permitted per 1,000 households
permits_per_1000_hh.source: US Census Bureau, Building Permits Survey (annual county file) and American Community Survey 5-year estimates, table B11001
